offers_products.reason: Sells Sabre Mosaic and SabreSonic software platforms and travel distribution technology to airlines, agencies and hotels.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from software platforms and booking transactions, not staff-delivered work; services are secondary.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are airlines, travel agencies, travel management companies and hotels; travelers use it only indirectly.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Airlines like Kenya Airways and Air Tanzania, agencies, TMCs and online travel sites buy its platform.

recurring_revenue.reason: Per-booking distribution fees and multi-year airline platform contracts repeat continuously.

cyclical_demand.reason: Booking volumes, which drive fees, fall when travel is cut in downturns; airline IT projects can be delayed.

big_ticket.reason: Revenue is mostly small per-booking fees and ongoing subscriptions, though airline platform migrations are large.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for software platform, data and transaction network, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are airlines, large travel management companies, online travel agencies and hotel groups.

asset_heavy.reason: Cloud-based software and data platform; growth needs engineering and cloud capacity rather than plants or fleets.
